brief: Sports betting and daily fantasy for adults 21+ in states where it's legal. Goal is first-deposit signups, and we have a big new-user promo. Regulated category.

profile.business_summary: A regulated sports betting and daily fantasy sports platform targeting adults aged 21 and older in legally permitted states, focusing on driving first-deposit signups through a promotional offer.
profile.product: Sports betting and daily fantasy sports platform
stated_claims: Sports betting and daily fantasy for adults 21+ in states where it's legal
profile.fulfillment_notes: Digital service available instantly upon signup and deposit in legal states.

relevant_tags.why: Sports betting and daily fantasy sports historically skew heavily toward male demographics.
High lifestyle overlap with sports viewing, casual entertainment, and adult-only social activities.
App-based entertainment fits quick-use, impulse-friendly digital consumption.

persona_conflicts.evidence: The product is sports betting and daily fantasy restricted to adults 21+.

note_signals.why: Late-night traffic spikes and impulse-friendly behavior align perfectly with live sports betting and fantasy sports engagement.
Audience of older affluent women with lower impulse behavior is a poor demographic fit for sports betting.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.54-$0.71 per click (median $0.63), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.54-$0.71 (median $0.63); bidding $0.38 wins ~0% of page views, paying ~$0.38 per click (second price)

phases.name: learning
phases.rule: planned bid per host; pacing only
phases.why: stable bids so measured rates aren't confounded

phases.name: maximize
phases.rule: planned bid x pacing x conversion likelihood, up to the ceiling

adjustments.reason: Under-delivering vs the daily plan -> bid up a little; over-delivering -> bid down.
Bid higher when the shopper looks like a likely converter (persona match vs the host's average shopper).

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget; the ceiling per host is the price that wins your 'balanced' share.
